parties: A.M. Leelawathie v. Sirisena Liyanaarachchi A.M. Leelawathie v. Sirisena Liyanaarachchi View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court’s judgement dismissing the Appellant’s action for a declaration of title and ejectment of the Defendant from the land in suit. Evidence adduced at the trial suggested co-ownership, and a partition action was deemed most appropriate. Held - seeing no reasons to interfere, Appeal dismissed without costs.
